Hi! I'm shopping but not sure what's right for me, can you help me choose?
Absolutely — I can help you choose.
Our main cat exercise product is the Cat Exercise Wheel. We designed it to help indoor cats burn energy, relieve stress, and build muscle, and it’s the best fit if your goal is giving your cat a dedicated way to run and stay active at home.
A few related items I found are mostly accessories or replacement parts, such as:
- Inline Wheel Kit - Light-up LED — an add-on for compatible wheels
- Inline Wheel Kit - Solid Black — replacement wheel kit
- Side Track Replacement Part — replacement component
- Woven Sisal Sleeve — for the scratching post, not the exercise wheel itself
So if you're trying to decide what’s right for you:
- Choose the Cat Exercise Wheel if you want the main exercise product for your cat
- Choose an inline wheel kit or side track only if you already own one of our wheels and need an upgrade or replacement
- Choose the Woven Sisal Sleeve only if you’re shopping for a scratching accessory
